# dsh-notify-win (fork)

Windows notifications for DeepSeek Harness: a native toast plus a taskbar flash when a
turn finishes
, fails, or needs your input.

> **Fork note.** Fork of Andyqwe44/dsh-notify-win
> (MIT). Event handling, toasts, question/approval

toasts, click-to-focus and the taskbar
> flash are the original author's work; the original `LICENS
E` is kept unchanged.
## What the fork changes

- **Custom notification cue** — `lib/notify.wav` (kalimba) is played by the resident helper
through

`winmm!PlaySound`, so the toast keeps the system look but gets our sound.
- **No doubled sound** — t

he toast's own `<audio>` is muted; only the bundled cue plays.
- **Turn-start cue** — `lib/start.wav

` (a double bell strike) plays when the agent picks
a turn up. It is a sound-only notice: the helper

's `sound` op plays the cue and creates
no toast, so it does not depend on the toast focus policy an

d never arms the taskbar flash.
- **App-style icon** — `icon.svg` in the plugin palette; the helper

registers it for the
AppUserModelID.
- **Prebuilt helper in the package** — `lib/dsh-toast-question.

exe` is committed and shipped,
so installing from GitHub does not require a .NET SDK.

Everything else behaves like upstream; see its README for the full event table and the
answer-toast

g else behaves like upstream; see its README for the full event table and the
answer-toast protocol.
## Requirements

- Windows 10/11;
- .NET 10 Desktop Runtime (the helper shows every toast; there is no PowerShell fal

ws 10/11;
- .NET 10 Desktop Runtime (the helper shows every toast; there is no PowerShell fallback).

ErrorCode`, `language` and the `*Title`/`*Body` strings are optional; defaults live in

## Languages / Языки

The default toast texts ship in three languages: **ru**, **en** and **zh**. That covers every
title

and body (done, compact, question, ask, cancelled, hook-cancelled, max-tokens, blocked,
error, unkno

wn stop, compaction failure), plus the error hints, the failure-code suffix and the
retry suffixes.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`language: auto` (the default) follows the system locale: `Intl.DateTimeFormat()` first, then
`LC_AL

L` / `LANG`, and English when neither is usable. A locale starting with `ru` or `zh`
selects that se

t; everything else is English. An explicit `ru`, `en` or `zh` wins over the
system locale.

Any text can still be overridden per key in the profile config, and such an override always
beats th

l be overridden per key in the profile config, and such an override always
beats the language table:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Sound

The toast cue is `lib/notify.wav` next to the helper: ~0.72 s, mono, 44.1 kHz, −13 dBFS with
a smoot

h tail. The turn-start cue is `lib/start.wav`: two struck A5 bells 0.22 s apart with a
~1.2 s tail,

so the start of a turn is unmistakably different from the completion cue. Both
are resolved next to

the helper: replace a file to change the sound, or point `startSoundFile`
at another bundled cue. A
missing file falls back to the system notification sound.
